description: This file defines the implementation of a PDCCH modulator class for a 5G/NR communication system, including resource block calculations, scrambling, modulation, and mapping functions.

classes.name: pdcch_modulator_impl
classes.description: Implementation of the PDCCH modulator, handling scrambling, modulation, and mapping of control channel data.

methods.name: scramble
methods.description: Scrambles input bits according to 3GPP TS38.211 Section 7.3.2.3.

methods.name: modulate
methods.description: Performs modulation of scrambled bits into complex symbols following TS38.211 Section 7.3.2.4.

methods.name: map
methods.description: Maps modulated symbols onto resource grid elements as per TS38.211 Section 7.3.2.5.

methods.name: modulate (public override)
methods.description: Main interface method to modulate data into resource grid.
